GAME UPGRADE ICON. One single object seen from above at about sixty degrees, centred, as an icon on a button in a top-down strategy game.

Images 1 and 2 are our approved icons from the same game: match their outline weight, shading, palette and finish only, not their shapes.

Create an ORIGINAL icon of a short piece of radio coaxial cable: one thick black cable lying in a loose S-curve from lower left to upper right. Its upper end has a chunky silver screw-on connector with a knurled nut and a gold centre pin. Its lower end is cut and stripped in steps so the layers show plainly: the black outer jacket, then a band of copper braid, then white insulation, then a bright copper centre wire.

It is one short cable, not a coil: no loops, no ring, no wheel, no tyre, no hose reel.

Style: an icon for the game RimWorld: a very thick near-black outline around every shape, bold simple shapes, flat cel shading with two or three tones per material, a muted palette with the copper and silver as the only bright colours, readable when shrunk to 64 pixels. Not a photograph, not a 3D render, not pixel art.

Draw ONLY the object, alone on a plain pure white background, filling about three quarters of the canvas. Square canvas. No people, hands, radios, antennas, text, letters, numbers, logos or brand marks.
